red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Chorus, host down in the lane. Still alive enough to carry symbiotes.
red_corridor.line_2: One bond makes one dependency. The rest crash with the host.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Movement. Failed egg. Thin shell. Still twitching.
red_corridor.line_2: Residue pays clean. Drag marks pay louder. Leaving it preserves time and loses the read.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Wall on my left is breathing out of sync with the rest of the corridor.
red_corridor.line_2: The seam wants contact. Cutting pays biomass and tissue; listening may quiet the lane.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Tracks in the membrane. Human stride. Old, but not ancient.
red_corridor.line_2: Chorus, prior entry signs. I mark the gait and do not stop.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Buzzing ahead. Low, wet, and getting closer.
red_corridor.line_2: Blood hunter in the lane. Killing pays biomass. Slipping past teaches it my route.

red_corridor.speaker: Her
red_corridor.line_1: Lane stays quiet. Heat steady. No movement worth spending blood on.
red_corridor.line_2: Quiet is not safe. It is only unpriced so far.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Amber sacs under the wall skin. Fresh. Pressurized.
amber_corridor.line_2: Harvest pays biomass. Sealing hardens me and invites residue. Refusal leaves the pressure intact.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Amber plaque opens a slot the size of my palm. Rates flex under the skin.
amber_corridor.line_2: Chorus, accounting organ live. Slot open. Pay for quiet or carry noise.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Something hard is set inside the amber. Tool shape. Bone edge under old metal.
amber_corridor.line_2: Breaking it pays now and cuts back. Testing may find the quiet angle. Clean hands lose the cache.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Heat's climbing. Resin's cooking in the walls.
amber_corridor.line_2: The corridor wants hesitation. I give it none.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: Something is dragging itself through the resin seams.
amber_corridor.line_2: Blood hunter. Amber stuck to its legs. Still fast enough.

amber_corridor.speaker: Her
amber_corridor.line_1: No rupture. No harvest. Just slow pulses under the skin.
amber_corridor.line_2: I leave the resin uncut. It keeps its pressure; I keep my scent lower.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: Split ahead. Left branch is soft and warm. Right branch is green spine and hard shell.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Soft growth mends and stains. Hard spine pays biomass and bites. Waiting lowers the lane's attention.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: Spores drifting low through the branch mouths. Fine enough to miss if I'm sloppy.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Clean passage lowers scent. Stirring them mends tissue and raises attention. Waiting buys a safer read.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: Chorus, baffle maplet in the wall. Lines show where breath goes when the wheel turns.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Muting buys quiet and declares a habit. Breaking pays parts and noise. Honest air keeps the debt clean.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: The spores split around a moving shape.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Spine stalker. Green dust on its shell. If I break sight, danger carries forward.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Her
split_green_corridor.line_1: The green holds. No rupture yet.
split_green_corridor.line_2: No gift, no cut, no new claim. I keep the branch from learning more.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: Fork around a swollen artery and a dry cracking lane.
split_red_corridor.line_2: One spills if I open it. One tears if I force it. Both cost.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: Pressure climbing in the walls. Whole split feels ready to burst.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Speed takes damage and noise. Venting pays biomass and lowers pressure. Falling back preserves the read.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_1: The artery bulges, then something peels off it.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Blood hunter. Fresh from the wall. No room to pretend it missed me.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Her
split_red_corridor.line_2: The split waits for a pattern. I give it distance instead.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Contact. Marrow sentinel in the lane. Still enough bone here to build an army.
bone_corridor.line_2: If I want what it guards, I cut it down.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Bone piles stacked waist high. Some of it human. Some of it definitely not.
bone_corridor.line_2: Scavenging pays biomass and wakes marrow nerves. Probing buys a quieter route. Refusal loses the pile.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Chorus, marked path offered. Clean. Too clean. The floor shows me where it wants my feet.
bone_corridor.line_2: Following lowers danger and builds obedience. Breaking the mark costs blood and resets the pattern.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Bone underfoot. Bone in the walls. Bone in the air.
bone_corridor.line_2: No fresh claim here. Only old intake and the route through it.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: Lamella lifts; ward plate-buds click, hungry to fuse to my stride.
bone_corridor.line_2: Grafting aligns me with plate logic. Refusal wakes the aisle and keeps my gait mine.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: A ridge-lathe shaves calcium, steady and clean.
bone_corridor.line_2: Stripping pays biomass. Probing keeps the lane quiet. Jamming it calls the guard function awake.

bone_corridor.speaker: Her
bone_corridor.line_1: The shaft pinches; osteal barbs taste my heat.
bone_corridor.line_2: Forcing through pays blood. Calling the hunter buys control of the contact. Withdrawal carries danger.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Her
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: Chorus, spikes forcing up through floor and wall. Lane is closing while I watch.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: Pushing through pays blood. Breaking a lane pays less cleanly. Withdrawal leaves the pressure behind me.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Her
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: Spines everywhere. No clean route. Just a least-worst one.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: I keep my center low and spend no extra blood.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Visual on the chamber core. Heart suspended center-mass. Keeper between me and it.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: If I want the chamber open, the keeper dies first.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Chamber pulse is syncing to my breathing. I don't like that.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: Observation lowers danger. Cutting pays biomass and corruption. Retreat keeps agency and raises pursuit.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Her
organ_chamber_red.line_1: Core's still beating. Whole room listens when it does.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: I do not match breath to pulse. I leave before it can count me.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: Pool ahead. Smells clean. Wrong kind of clean.
healing_pool.line_2: Drinking mends and stains. Studying cools corruption. Retreat preserves the boundary.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: Surface moved before I touched it. Something under there reacts before contact.
healing_pool.line_2: Breaking the skin lets it answer first. Sampling keeps distance. Leaving it still denies the invitation.

healing_pool.speaker: Her
healing_pool.line_1: No splash. No movement. Glow stays steady.
healing_pool.line_2: Nothing asks, so I give it nothing.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: Egg line both sides. Full sacs. One already open.
egg_corridor.line_2: Harvest feeds me and stains the run. Burning costs blood. Slipping through keeps the nest ignorant.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: Cracked shell on the right. Whatever hatched left fluid and drag marks.
egg_corridor.line_2: Shell residue pays quiet biomass. Drag marks pay more and raise danger. Leaving loses the trail.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: One egg opens wrong. The thing inside is already standing.
egg_corridor.line_2: Small spine stalker. Killing clears the nest for biomass. Slipping away leaves hunger behind me.

egg_corridor.speaker: Her
egg_corridor.line_1: Nest stays still. That's worse than noise.
egg_corridor.line_2: I keep my steps light. No shell breaks. No scent blooms.

corruption_spike_room.speaker: Her
corruption_spike_room.line_1: Chorus, spikes breaching ahead. Bone pressure's rising fast.
corruption_spike_room.line_2: If I push through, I pay for it in blood.

symbiote_host_offer.speaker: Her
symbiote_host_offer.line_1: Chorus, another host down. Three symbiotes still clinging to it.
symbiote_host_offer.line_2: One bond saves one tool. The rest die when the host crashes.

merchant_arrival.speaker: Her
merchant_arrival.line_1: Chorus, contact. Exchange interface present. Instruction?
merchant_arrival.line_2: No reply. His scales are already open, prices wet on the weights.

danger_spike_notice.speaker: Her
danger_spike_notice.line_1: Chorus, adrenaline climbing. Corridor's reacting to it. I'm getting louder to this place.
danger_spike_notice.line_2: Next contact will come faster. So will I.

director_corruption_warning.speaker: Her
director_corruption_warning.line_1: Chorus, the walls flex when I move now. Not away from me. With me.
director_corruption_warning.line_2: Gifts sit in me. The place is learning my tissue.

director_dependence_warning.speaker: Her
director_dependence_warning.line_1: Chorus, something under my skin answers before I finish deciding.
director_dependence_warning.line_2: Useful. Bad sign. Dependence is learning my timing.

director_danger_warning.speaker: Her
director_danger_warning.line_1: Chorus, buzzing behind me. Same distance for three rooms.
director_danger_warning.line_2: Avoiding teeth still leaves a trail. The debt is distance.

director_greed_warning.speaker: Her
director_greed_warning.line_1: Chorus, harvest marks on my gloves. On my tail. In the air.
director_greed_warning.line_2: The organism knows what I stop for. Appetite is becoming route data.

director_safety_warning.speaker: Her
director_safety_warning.line_1: Chorus, every quiet route is narrower than the last.
director_safety_warning.line_2: The place is pricing caution in distance and sealed doors.

director_combat_warning.speaker: Her
director_combat_warning.line_1: Chorus, dead things behind me. Warm biomass ahead.
director_combat_warning.line_2: Killing through every room is still noise.

director_debt_warning.speaker: Her
director_debt_warning.line_1: Chorus, resin clicks behind me. Not pursuit. Accounting.
director_debt_warning.line_2: The merchant does not need to be in the room to keep a ledger. Refusal has a pulse.

smother_hunter_arrival.speaker: Her
smother_hunter_arrival.line_1: Air stops moving. My last quiet lane folds shut behind me.
smother_hunter_arrival.line_2: Smother hunter. It learned the places I muted.

plate_snare.speaker: Her
plate_snare.line_1: Chorus, the plate line remembers my stride. Floor and wall close in the same rhythm.
plate_snare.line_2: I followed too clean. Now it wants to pin the route to my bones.

hunter_reckoning.speaker: Her
hunter_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the buzzing stops chasing. It arrives.
hunter_reckoning.line_2: Blood hunter in the lane. This is the bill for all that distance.

corruption_claim.speaker: Her
corruption_claim.line_1: Chorus, my hands open without asking me. The walls open back.
corruption_claim.line_2: Too much of this place fits me. I lose the boundary.

merchant_reckoning.speaker: Her
merchant_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the corridor opens into his scale room. No side paths. No bargain left.
merchant_reckoning.line_2: I ran from him too often. Now he wants all of me on the scale.

floor_transition.speaker: Her
floor_transition.line_1: Layer break. Pressure changed. Smell changed. Rules probably changed too.
floor_transition.line_2: I reset my breathing and keep moving.
